The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust implementation of the risk assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.85 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.39s. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if expanding to AWS-based runtimes.
